    78	func processVPAUpdate(r *recommender, vpa *model.Vpa, observedVpa *vpaautoscalingv1.VerticalPodAutoscaler) {
    79		resources := r.podResourceRecommender.GetRecommendedPodResources(GetContainerNameToAggregateStateMap(vpa))
    80		had := vpa.HasRecommendation()
    81	
    82		listOfResourceRecommendation := logic.MapToListOfRecommendedContainerResources(resources, r.recommendationFormat)
    83	
    84		for _, postProcessor := range r.recommendationPostProcessor {
    85			listOfResourceRecommendation = postProcessor.Process(observedVpa, listOfResourceRecommendation)
    86		}
    87	
    88		vpa.UpdateRecommendation(listOfResourceRecommendation)
    89		if vpa.HasRecommendation() && !had {
    90			metrics_recommender.ObserveRecommendationLatency(vpa.Created)
    91		}
    92		hasMatchingPods := vpa.PodCount > 0
    93		vpa.UpdateConditions(hasMatchingPods)
    94		if err := r.clusterState.RecordRecommendation(vpa, time.Now()); err != nil {
    95			klog.V(0).InfoS("", "err", err)
    96			if klog.V(4).Enabled() {
    97				pods := r.clusterState.GetMatchingPods(vpa)
    98				if len(pods) != vpa.PodCount {
    99					klog.ErrorS(nil, "ClusterState pod count and matching pods disagree for VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpa.ID.VpaName), "podCount", vpa.PodCount, "matchingPods", pods)
   100				}
   101				klog.InfoS("VPA dump", "vpa", vpa, "hasMatchingPods", hasMatchingPods, "podCount", vpa.PodCount, "matchingPods", pods)
   102			}
   103		}
   104	
   105		_, err := vpa_utils.UpdateVpaStatusIfNeeded(
   106			r.vpaClient.VerticalPodAutoscalers(vpa.ID.Namespace), vpa.ID.VpaName, vpa.AsStatus(), &observedVpa.Status)
   107		if err != nil {
   108			klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot update VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpa.ID.VpaName))
   109		}

   112	// UpdateVPAs update VPA CRD objects' status.
   113	func (r *recommender) UpdateVPAs() {
   114		cnt := metrics_recommender.NewObjectCounter()
   115		defer cnt.Observe()
   116	
   117		// Create a channel to send VPA updates to workers
   118		vpaUpdates := make(chan *vpaautoscalingv1.VerticalPodAutoscaler, len(r.clusterState.ObservedVPAs()))
   119	
   120		// Create a wait group to wait for all workers to finish
   121		var wg sync.WaitGroup
   122	
   123		// Start workers
   124		for i := 0; i < r.updateWorkerCount; i++ {
   125			wg.Go(func() {
   126				for observedVpa := range vpaUpdates {
   127					key := model.VpaID{
   128						Namespace: observedVpa.Namespace,
   129						VpaName:   observedVpa.Name,
   130					}
   131	
   132					vpa, found := r.clusterState.VPAs()[key]
   133					if !found {
   134						return
   135					}
   136					processVPAUpdate(r, vpa, observedVpa)
   137					cnt.Add(vpa)
   138				}
   139			})
   140		}
   141	
   142		// Send VPA updates to the workers
   143		for _, observedVpa := range r.clusterState.ObservedVPAs() {
   144			vpaUpdates <- observedVpa
   145		}
   146	
   147		// Close the channel to signal workers to stop
   148		close(vpaUpdates)
   149	
   150		// Wait for all workers to finish
   151		wg.Wait()
   152	}

   174		timer.ObserveStep("LoadVPAs")
   175	
   176		r.clusterStateFeeder.LoadPods()

   186

    56	func isFetchingHistory(vpa *model.Vpa) bool {

    60	func getVpasToCheckpoint(clusterVpas map[model.VpaID]*model.Vpa) []*model.Vpa {
    61		vpas := make([]*model.Vpa, 0, len(clusterVpas))
    62		for _, vpa := range clusterVpas {
    63			if isFetchingHistory(vpa) {
    64				klog.V(3).InfoS("VPA is loading history, skipping checkpoints", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpa.ID.VpaName))
    65				continue
    66			}
    67			vpas = append(vpas, vpa)
    68		}
    69		slices.SortFunc(vpas, func(a, b *model.Vpa) int {
    70			return a.CheckpointWritten.Compare(b.CheckpointWritten)
    71		})
    72		return vpas
    73	}

    75	func processCheckpointUpdateForVPA(vpa *model.Vpa, writer *checkpointWriter) {
    76		now := time.Now()
    77		aggregateContainerStateMap := buildAggregateContainerStateMap(vpa, writer.cluster, now)
    78		for container, aggregatedContainerState := range aggregateContainerStateMap {
    79			containerCheckpoint, err := aggregatedContainerState.SaveToCheckpoint()
    80			if err != nil {
    81				klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot serialize checkpoint", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpa.ID.VpaName), "container", container)
    82				continue
    83			}
    84			checkpointName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", vpa.ID.VpaName, container)
    85			vpaCheckpoint := vpa_types.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoint{
    86				ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: checkpointName},
    87				Spec: vpa_types.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpointSpec{
    88					ContainerName: container,
    89					VPAObjectName: vpa.ID.VpaName,
    90				},
    91				Status: *containerCheckpoint,
    92			}
    93			err = api_util.CreateOrUpdateVpaCheckpoint(writer.vpaCheckpointClient.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoints(vpa.ID.Namespace), &vpaCheckpoint)
    94			if err != nil {
    95				klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot save checkpoint for VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpaCheckpoint.Spec.VPAObjectName), "container", vpaCheckpoint.Spec.ContainerName)
    96			} else {
    97				klog.V(3).InfoS("Saved checkpoint for VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpaCheckpoint.Spec.VPAObjectName), "container", vpaCheckpoint.Spec.ContainerName)
    98				vpa.CheckpointWritten = now
    99			}
   100		}
   101	}

   103	func (writer *checkpointWriter) StoreCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, concurrentWorkers int) {
   104		vpas := getVpasToCheckpoint(writer.cluster.VPAs())
   105	
   106		// Create a channel to send VPA updates to workers
   107		vpaCheckpointUpdates := make(chan *model.Vpa, len(vpas))
   108	
   109		// Create a wait group to wait for all workers to finish
   110		var wg sync.WaitGroup
   111		// Start workers. Each worker processes at least one checkpoint before checking for a cancelled context.
   112		for range concurrentWorkers {
   113			wg.Go(func() {
   114				for vpaToCheckpoint := range vpaCheckpointUpdates {
   115					processCheckpointUpdateForVPA(vpaToCheckpoint, writer)
   116					select {
   117					case <-ctx.Done():
   118						return
   119					default:
   120					}
   121				}
   122			})
   123		}
   124	
   125		// Send VPA Checkpoint updates to the workers
   126		for _, vpa := range vpas {
   127			vpaCheckpointUpdates <- vpa
   128		}
   129	
   130		// Close the channel to signal workers to stop after draining the channel
   131		close(vpaCheckpointUpdates)
   132	
   133		// Wait for all workers to finish
   134		wg.Wait()
   135	
   136		if ctx.Err() != nil {
   137			klog.V(0).InfoS("Failed to store all checkpoints within the configured `checkpoints-timeout`", "err", ctx.Err())
   138		}
   139	}

   141	// Build the AggregateContainerState for the purpose of the checkpoint. This is an aggregation of state of all
   142	// containers that belong to pods matched by the VPA.
   143	// Note however that we exclude the most recent memory peak for each container (see below).
   144	func buildAggregateContainerStateMap(vpa *model.Vpa, cluster model.ClusterState, now time.Time) map[string]*model.AggregateContainerState {
   145		aggregateContainerStateMap := vpa.AggregateStateByContainerName()
   146		// Note: the memory peak from the current (ongoing) aggregation interval is not included in the
   147		// checkpoint to avoid having multiple peaks in the same interval after the state is restored from
   148		// the checkpoint. Therefore we are extracting the current peak from all containers.
   149		// TODO: Avoid the nested loop over all containers for each VPA.
   150		for _, pod := range cluster.Pods() {
   151			for containerName, container := range pod.Containers {
   152				aggregateKey := cluster.MakeAggregateStateKey(pod, containerName)
   153				if vpa.UsesAggregation(aggregateKey) {
   154					if aggregateContainerState, exists := aggregateContainerStateMap[containerName]; exists {
   155						subtractCurrentContainerMemoryPeak(aggregateContainerState, container, now)
   156					}
   157				}
   158			}
   159		}
   160		return aggregateContainerStateMap
   161	}

   163	func subtractCurrentContainerMemoryPeak(a *model.AggregateContainerState, container *model.ContainerState, now time.Time) {
   164		if now.Before(container.WindowEnd) {

   166		}
   167	}

   289	func (feeder *clusterStateFeeder) GarbageCollectCheckpoints(ctx context.Context) {
   290		klog.V(3).InfoS("Starting garbage collection of checkpoints")
   291	
   292		allVPAKeys := map[model.VpaID]bool{}
   293	
   294		allVpaResources, err := feeder.vpaLister.List(labels.Everything())
   295		if err != nil {
   296			klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot list VPAs")
   297			return
   298		}
   299		for _, vpa := range allVpaResources {
   300			vpaID := model.VpaID{
   301				Namespace: vpa.Namespace,
   302				VpaName:   vpa.Name,
   303			}
   304			allVPAKeys[vpaID] = true
   305		}
   306	
   307		checkpointList, err := feeder.vpaCheckpointLister.List(labels.Everything())
   308		if err != nil {
   309			klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot list VPA checkpoints")
   310			return
   311		}
   312	
   313		for _, checkpoint := range checkpointList {
   314			// Skip the checkpoint if any of the following conditions are true:
   315			// 1. `vpaObjectNamespace` is set and doesn't match the checkpoint's namespace.
   316			// 2. `ignoredNamespaces` is set and contains the checkpoint's namespace.
   317			if feeder.shouldIgnoreNamespace(checkpoint.Namespace) {
   318				klog.V(3).InfoS("Skipping checkpoint; its namespace does not meet cleanup criteria", "checkpoint", klog.KObj(checkpoint), "vpaObjectNamespace", feeder.vpaObjectNamespace, "ignoredNamespaces", feeder.ignoredNamespaces)
   319				continue
   320			}
   321			vpaID := model.VpaID{Namespace: checkpoint.Namespace, VpaName: checkpoint.Spec.VPAObjectName}
   322			if !allVPAKeys[vpaID] {
   323				if err := feeder.vpaCheckpointClient.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoints(checkpoint.Namespace).Delete(ctx, checkpoint.Name, metav1.DeleteOptions{}); err != nil {
   324					klog.ErrorS(err, "Orphaned VPA checkpoint cleanup - failed to delete", "checkpoint", klog.KObj(checkpoint))
   325					continue
   326				}
   327				klog.V(3).InfoS("Orphaned VPA checkpoint cleanup - deleting", "checkpoint", klog.KObj(checkpoint))
   328			}
   329		}
   330	}

   332	func (feeder *clusterStateFeeder) shouldIgnoreNamespace(namespace string) bool {
   333		// 1. `vpaObjectNamespace` is set but doesn't match the current namespace.
   334		if feeder.vpaObjectNamespace != "" && namespace != feeder.vpaObjectNamespace {
   335			return true
   336		}
   337		// 2. `ignoredNamespaces` is set, and the current namespace is in the list.
   338		if len(feeder.ignoredNamespaces) > 0 && slices.Contains(feeder.ignoredNamespaces, namespace) {
   339			return true
   340		}
   341		return false
   342	}

   176	// Run starts the recommender loop and blocks until ctx is cancelled.
   177	// It implements controllercontext.Controller.
   178	func (c *RecommenderController) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
   179		if err := initHistoryProvider(ctx, c.recommender, c.config); err != nil {
   180			return err
   181		}
   182	
   183		c.healthCheck.StartMonitoring()
   184	
   185		ticker := time.NewTicker(c.config.MetricsFetcherInterval)
   186		defer ticker.Stop()
   187	
   188		for {
   189			select {
   190			case <-ctx.Done():
   191				return ctx.Err()
   192			case <-ticker.C:
   193				c.recommender.RunOnce()
   194				c.healthCheck.UpdateLastActivity()
   195			}
   196		}
   197	}

   155		if r.useCheckpoints {

   157	
   158			if time.Since(r.lastCheckpointGC) > r.checkpointsGCInterval {

   165	func (r *recommender) RunOnce() {
   166		timer := metrics_recommender.NewExecutionTimer()
   167		defer timer.ObserveTotal()
   168	
   169		ctx := context.Background()
   170	
   171		klog.V(3).InfoS("Recommender Run")
   172	
   173		r.clusterStateFeeder.LoadVPAs(ctx)
   174		timer.ObserveStep("LoadVPAs")
   175	
   176		r.clusterStateFeeder.LoadPods()
   177		timer.ObserveStep("LoadPods")
   178	
   179		r.clusterStateFeeder.LoadRealTimeMetrics(ctx)
   180		timer.ObserveStep("LoadMetrics")
   181	
   182		r.clusterStateFeeder.DeleteRemovedPods()
   183		timer.ObserveStep("DeleteRemovedPods")
   184	
   185		klog.V(3).InfoS("ClusterState is tracking", "pods", len(r.clusterState.Pods()), "vpas", len(r.clusterState.VPAs()))
   186	
   187		r.UpdateVPAs()
   188		timer.ObserveStep("UpdateVPAs")
   189	
   190		stepCtx, cancelFunc := context.WithDeadline(ctx, time.Now().Add(r.checkpointsWriteTimeout))
   191		defer cancelFunc()
   192		r.MaintainCheckpoints(stepCtx)
   193		timer.ObserveStep("MaintainCheckpoints")
   194	
   195		r.clusterState.RateLimitedGarbageCollectAggregateCollectionStates(ctx, time.Now(), r.controllerFetcher)
   196		timer.ObserveStep("GarbageCollect")
   197		klog.V(3).InfoS("ClusterState is tracking", "aggregateContainerStates", r.clusterState.StateMapSize())
   198	}

    75	func processCheckpointUpdateForVPA(vpa *model.Vpa, writer *checkpointWriter) {
    76		now := time.Now()
    77		aggregateContainerStateMap := buildAggregateContainerStateMap(vpa, writer.cluster, now)
    78		for container, aggregatedContainerState := range aggregateContainerStateMap {
    79			containerCheckpoint, err := aggregatedContainerState.SaveToCheckpoint()
    80			if err != nil {
    81				klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot serialize checkpoint", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpa.ID.VpaName), "container", container)
    82				continue
    83			}
    84			checkpointName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", vpa.ID.VpaName, container)
    85			vpaCheckpoint := vpa_types.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoint{
    86				ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: checkpointName},
    87				Spec: vpa_types.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpointSpec{
    88					ContainerName: container,
    89					VPAObjectName: vpa.ID.VpaName,
    90				},
    91				Status: *containerCheckpoint,
    92			}
    93			err = api_util.CreateOrUpdateVpaCheckpoint(writer.vpaCheckpointClient.VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoints(vpa.ID.Namespace), &vpaCheckpoint)
    94			if err != nil {
    95				klog.ErrorS(err, "Cannot save checkpoint for VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpaCheckpoint.Spec.VPAObjectName), "container", vpaCheckpoint.Spec.ContainerName)
    96			} else {
    97				klog.V(3).InfoS("Saved checkpoint for VPA", "vpa", klog.KRef(vpa.ID.Namespace, vpaCheckpoint.Spec.VPAObjectName), "container", vpaCheckpoint.Spec.ContainerName)
    98				vpa.CheckpointWritten = now
    99			}
   100		}
   101	}

   103	func (writer *checkpointWriter) StoreCheckpoints(ctx context.Context, concurrentWorkers int) {
   104		vpas := getVpasToCheckpoint(writer.cluster.VPAs())
   105	
   106		// Create a channel to send VPA updates to workers
   107		vpaCheckpointUpdates := make(chan *model.Vpa, len(vpas))
   108	
   109		// Create a wait group to wait for all workers to finish
   110		var wg sync.WaitGroup
   111		// Start workers. Each worker processes at least one checkpoint before checking for a cancelled context.
   112		for range concurrentWorkers {
   113			wg.Go(func() {
   114				for vpaToCheckpoint := range vpaCheckpointUpdates {
   115					processCheckpointUpdateForVPA(vpaToCheckpoint, writer)
   116					select {
   117					case <-ctx.Done():
   118						return
   119					default:
   120					}
   121				}
   122			})
   123		}
   124	
   125		// Send VPA Checkpoint updates to the workers
   126		for _, vpa := range vpas {
   127			vpaCheckpointUpdates <- vpa
   128		}
   129	
   130		// Close the channel to signal workers to stop after draining the channel
   131		close(vpaCheckpointUpdates)
   132	
   133		// Wait for all workers to finish
   134		wg.Wait()
   135	
   136		if ctx.Err() != nil {
   137			klog.V(0).InfoS("Failed to store all checkpoints within the configured `checkpoints-timeout`", "err", ctx.Err())
   138		}
   139	}
